kypExtensions.summary: The denominator family and the clock rule — the two-question decoder that sorts every 'rate' on the facing pages: WHAT is being divided (population -> mortality rate; exposed -> attack rate; cases -> case fatality rate, book 258) and IS there a time unit in the formula (per year -> a true rate, annualize the window; no unit -> a proportion, never annualize). Answers the exam's two planted errors: dividing 60 by the town's 10,000 (wrong denominator) and reporting 8 per 1000 as a per-year rate (wrong clock).
kypExtensions.rationale: First Aid prints the two rows' definitions, examples, and formulas but never states the denominator family, the rate-vs-proportion distinction, or the two-question decode order; the synthesis is KYP's.
kypExtensions.location: core.keyIdea + mechanisms[0] vital-rate-denominators-map + blocks[3] the list block + blocks[5] the compare block + the registry visual's Zone A decoder strip

kypExtensions.summary: The step-by-step dissection of both printed worked examples: the mortality example's two hidden operations (80 deaths ÷ 10,000 people × 1000 = 8 per 1000 ACROSS the 2-year window; ÷ 2 years = 4 per 1000 PER YEAR) and the attack example's one-step fraction (60 ill ÷ 80 exposed = 75%, with the town's 10,000 documented as the never-entering decoy).
kypExtensions.rationale: The source prints the worked examples' results only ('mortality rate is 4 per 1000 per year', 'attack rate is 75%'); the intermediate arithmetic and the decoy analysis are KYP's.
kypExtensions.location: core.why + mechanisms[0] + blocks[3] the list block + blocks[5] the compare block + the registry visual's Zone A arithmetic strips

kypExtensions.summary: The four-move population-pyramid reading protocol (MOVE 1 read the BASE — wide = growing, narrow = declining; MOVE 2 compare the sides — triangle / rectangle / bulging barrel; MOVE 3 attach the arrows — birth rate swings twice, mortality once; MOVE 4 name the trajectory — Growing / Stable / Declining) plus the shape-to-stage mapping itself, with the shapes VLM-pinned from the source figure (wide-based classic triangle, even rectangle, narrow base with a bulging middle) since they do not exist in the text layer.
kypExtensions.rationale: The source draws the three pyramids and prints the four rows but never states a reading order, never captions the shapes with their stages (VLM: the stage columns are not separately labeled), and never notes the arrow-count asymmetry; the protocol is KYP's.
kypExtensions.location: core.keyIdea + mechanisms[1] development-pyramid-map + blocks[4] the steps block + blocks[1] the transition table block + the registry visual's Zone B pyramids and Zone C rows
